integrity_boundary.policy: Do not infer archival approval, reuse permission, endorsement, or cultural authorization from current discoverability while the indexed submission/approval-state metadata is internally conflicting.

promotion.promotion_level: first-party repository identity + file locator + pagination + repository-declared checksum metadata only
promotion.reason_counts_unchanged: The work is retained as a high-quality discovery/manifestation lead until deterministic reconciliation against the numbered WEB-MUN/source register and permitted byte-level verification are complete.

explicit_gaps: Obtain the permitted PDF through a byte-preserving path and independently compute its hash.
Reconcile iv+90 repository pagination against the acquired PDF page inventory before page-level citations.
Resolve the repository search index's rejected-submission metadata against the currently public item record.
Determine explicit reuse/redistribution terms before textual ingestion.
Do not infer participant consent, community validation, or cultural-access authorization from repository availability.
Deterministically reconcile the work against WEB-MUN/source identities before changing controlled MMSC counts.
